openings.claim: Retain confusion counting (paired predictions/available labels grouped into cells) and selection logging, but remove table-to-selection feedback permanently. A fixed itinerary may yield reproducible bounded decisions: freeze it before counting, prioritize flagged prediction-disagreeing rows, cycle their slices, tie by supplied identifier. Table outputs cannot reorder/supplement it; adjudications feed counting and logging separately.
openings.discriminator: The nearest rival adaptively selects from current confusion-table deficits with the same log. The itinerary sometimes yields different inspected identifiers and advance/reject/unresolved reports; better decision support is unknown. Its proposed advantage fails if the rival produces more supported, key-consistent decisions within equal resources.
openings.probe: Run matched copies with independently reset sixteen-row allowances and identical four preselected withheld flagged rows. Log each attempted identifier, selection criterion, result/withholding and allowance consumed; unsuccessful access costs none. Freeze both reports within seventy minutes each. Compute total/slice improvement intervals: resolved supplied labels give exact paired correctness differences; unresolved flagged rows give zero when predictions agree, otherwise [-1,1]. Advance iff total lower bound >=4 and every slice lower bound >=-2; reject iff total upper bound <4 or any slice upper bound <-2; otherwise unresolved. Open the full-label decision key after both reports freeze. Compare key consistency, supported decisions, inspected identifiers, affected slices, adjudications and time. Wide intervals after sixteen adjudications or excessive computation defeat practical usefulness; the cap alone proves neither feasibility nor information gain.
openings.uncertainty: Accept unflagged supplied labels as given. Itinerary construction, counting and interval computation fitting the supplied spreadsheet/script environment and seventy minutes remain unverified; declared fit is uncertain.

lineage.reason: Causal interface removal, rival/defeat tests and resource uncertainty retained.

decision: Probe using supplied records/labels only, unchanged thresholds and at most sixteen adjudications. Report uncertainty when the cap prevents support; this supplies no deployment-readiness evidence.
